name: Beeline
description: Your personal travel agent, built into Claude. Search, book, and manage flights and hotels from major airlines and hotels worldwide. Beeline allows you not just to book but also to change a booking, add a request, or cancel - all directly in Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Beeline to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Beeline to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.onbeeline.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Beeline MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Beeline lists 25 MCP tools, including book_ancillaries, cancel_booking, cancel_flight, check_flight_availability, check_room_availability, collect_guest_details, collect_passenger_details, create_pending_flight_booking, create_pending_hotel_booking, estimate_booking_cancellation, estimate_flight_cancellation, and get_available_ancillaries.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Beeline?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Beeline in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.
Beeline requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Beeline is developed by Beeline Technologies Ltd. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
